project_type: Python robot-arm toolkit (normakit) with MuJoCo digital twin, LeRobot 0.4.4, FastAPI policy server
verification_instructions: Run both test commands; run new eval script in sim with small episode count.
setup_instructions: use existing .venv (mujoco 3.2.7, torch 2.12 cpu/cu126, gymnasium, lerobot 0.4.4)
environment_constraints: Laptop NVIDIA driver broken: no GPU training locally; A100 remote (A100_HOST, POLICY_API_TOKEN env). Never move real arm. Do not touch uncommitted team files (.mcp.json, norma, scripts/autorun.py, src/normakit/kin.py, station_backend.py, vision.py, untracked assets/calibration). Do not edit core.py Guard limits.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: document in CHANGELOG.md and docs/ISSUES.md; no API keys; first real motion one motor small delta slow
key_patterns: MujocoBackend in src/normakit/mujoco_backend.py (ST3215 model, norms 0..1, send_goals, step_seconds, cup_pos); scene assets/mujoco/elrobot_scene.xml; policy schema src/normakit/policy_api.py; server/policy_server.py; scripts/run_policy.py
directory_structure: src/normakit library, scripts CLI, server A100 server, docs, assets/mujoco
